evidence.reason: The activation wait uses the total repair-completion count as its baseline and waits for any additional completion. Since `before["repair_completions"]` is unfiltered and the call passes no runtime, a prior-runtime completion arriving in the pre-mask window can satisfy the wait before the released runtime completes. The subsequent snapshot then has no released-runtime entry to collect, causing a false failure. Filtering both baseline and wait by `spec["runtime"]` is the smallest compatible fix.
